newsitem.title: USA: MCI, BT, Telebras in deal.
newsitem.headline: MCI, BT, Telebras in deal.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Telecomunicacoes Brasileiras SA, or Telebras, will start offering Concert Communications Services in Brazil by September.
The companies said Concert Communications Services, launched in July 1994 and headquartered in Reston, Va., develops "advanced networking services" for multinational businesses.
The companies said the Concert portfolio includes: Concert Virtual Network Service, Concert Packet Services, Concert Managed Bandwidth Service, and Concert InternetPlus.
On November 3, 1996, MCI announced a definitive agreement to merge with British Telecomunications Plc. Concert is a joint venture of MCI and British Telecom.
